concerns: BLOCKING DESIGN FINDING. The start sequence's `compress` step fails on the demo: `python manage.py compress` raises compressor.exceptions.OfflineGenerationError ('No compress template tags found in templates') because no template in fairdm/, demo/ or the django-mvp packages uses {% compress %}. Plan P3 and decision D8 assumed removing the two COMPRESS lines was enough; it is not. With COMPRESS_OFFLINE on and zero compress blocks the command exits 1, so FR-005's start sequence cannot succeed for the demo or any portal laid out like it. Confirmed three ways: (1) the smoke test's web start fails at compress with that error; (2) the same container with migrate, collectstatic and gunicorn only answers 200 on / with X-Forwarded-Proto: https; (3) a throwaway image adding one template `{% load compress static %}{% compress css %}<link ...>{% endcompress %}` makes compress exit 0 and the whole smoke test pass (12 ok lines, exit 0). Choices for Forge/Sam: add a compress block to a FairDM template (a product change outside this story's files), drop `compress` from D4/FR-005/the entrypoint, or make the step conditional. I did none of them. Smoke test output against the demo image: ok x6 (runtime has libpq, uv; neither image contains FairDM; dev has gcc and git; database reachable) then FAIL: smoke-web exited before answering on port 8000, last log line compressor.exceptions.OfflineGenerationError.

docs/portal-development/production.md carries a note that `compress` stops with an error when no template uses {% compress %}, because that is what the branch does today. Remove or reword it once the compress question is settled.

Smoke test with all checks, passing run against the probe image: ok the runtime image has the PostgreSQL client library / has uv / fairdm-base:local does not contain FairDM / fairdm-base:local-dev does not contain FairDM / the development image has gcc and git / the database is reachable from a container on network fairdm-smoke / the portal migrated, collected, compressed and answered 200 on port 8000 / the server does not run as root / GDAL and GEOS load with no library path set / PORT=8123 makes the portal answer on port 8123 / the worker command started Celery and ran none of the web start sequence / with the database unreachable the container exits 1 and the server never starts / all checks passed.

The production environment needed exactly: DJANGO_SECRET_KEY (50+ chars), DJANGO_SITE_DOMAIN, POSTGRES_HOST, POSTGRES_PORT, POSTGRES_DB, POSTGRES_USER, POSTGRES_PASSWORD, REDIS_URL (fairdm.E200 refuses the placeholder cache), plus X-Forwarded-Proto: https on requests. The guide lists them.
Celery logs 'ready.' only at INFO, so the smoke test starts the worker with `worker --loglevel INFO --concurrency 1`, which also exercises argument pass-through.
